about: Wiring Rules Reader update list. The app reads this file each time it opens online. Add a new amendment or ruling to 'items' when one is published, and anything else worth telling users to 'notices'. Every entry needs a unique id. Users who tap OK won’t see that id again.

notices.title: A new edition of AS/NZS 3000 is on the way
notices.text: The Wiring Rules are being revised. A draft is expected for public comment in the second half of 2026, and the new edition is due around mid-2027. The 2018 edition stays the one cited in NZ until the regulations change.
